title: REQ · BootScene spawns NPCs from scene data and reports their interaction
summary: BootScene creates and animates one sprite per scene character and emits characterClick with the interaction dialogue id when an NPC is clicked.
description: Context: BootScene.createCharacter spawns and animates sprites from scene.characters but a click only plays the interact animation. Desired behavior: add a characterClick event to PhaserToReactEvents and emit it from the sprite pointerdown handler when the spec has an interaction. Expected result: React can open the NPC dialogue without engine changes. Why: completes data-driven NPC support.
acceptance_criteria: Given scene.characters with two entries, When create runs, Then add.sprite is called twice with each position and each sprite plays its idle animation.
Given a character with interaction.dialogue 'greet', When pointerdown fires, Then characterClick is emitted with { id, dialogue: 'greet' }.
Given a character without interaction, When pointerdown fires, Then no characterClick is emitted and the interact animation still plays.
definition_of_done: Event typed and emitted; sprites spawn per scene character
